summary: Lobby/Waiting Room features tested for AI KARAU Meeting Platform. Backend: 12/12 passed (3 skipped due to test user unavailable). Frontend: Dashboard, Lobby, and Guest Join flows all working correctly. All new lobby features implemented and functional.

issues: Minor: video-preview data-testid not matched when camera off (shows avatar with initial instead)

backend_api_tests: POST /api/auth/login - Admin login returns 200 with access_token
POST /api/karau-meet/meetings/{id}/lobby/join - Guest placed in waiting status
POST /api/karau-meet/meetings/{id}/lobby/deny - Host denies guest, status changes to rejected
GET /api/karau-meet/meetings/{id}/lobby/waiting - Host views waiting list with count
POST /api/karau-meet/meetings/{id}/lobby/admit-all - All waiting guests admitted at once
PUT /api/karau-meet/meetings/{id}/settings/waiting-room?enabled=false - Waiting room disabled, guests auto-admitted
GET /api/karau-meet/meetings/{id}/info - Public endpoint returns title, host_name, status
frontend_ui_tests: Login page loads with email/password inputs
Dashboard loads after login with 'Welcome back, Admin!'
Dashboard shows 'Start Instant Meeting' and 'Join Meeting' cards
MeetingLobby component renders with meeting title and host info
Lobby shows mic toggle, video toggle, background picker, device settings buttons
Guest Join Page (/karau-meet/join/{id}) shows meeting title and name input
Lobby shows user avatar with initial when camera is off (expected in headless)

critical_code_review_comments: useVirtualBackground.js: Skin tone protection implemented correctly with HSL color manipulation
MeetingLobby.jsx: Well-structured Teams-style lobby with video preview, device settings, background picker
karau_meet.py routes: All 8 lobby endpoints implemented with proper auth checks
meeting_service.py: Waiting room functions use in-memory storage (acceptable for MVP, consider Redis for scale)
MeetingRoom.jsx: lobby_guest_waiting WS handler shows toast with Admit action button
